citations.narrative:
The facility is conducting regulated activity without a licensee. The facility has been previously licensed, but their license
expired over a year ago. They have continued to exhibit regulated animals without a license since then. Exhibiting without
a license doesn't allow APHIS officials to properly assess the health and well-being of the animals by allowing us to
conduct routine inspections on a regular basis. The facility must discontinue their exhibition of regulated animals until they
have a USDA license. Correct starting 7/28/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
No regulated activities may be conducted until a USDA license is obtained.
End of report.
